giveaway.prompt: Starting a new giveaway. Forward me the channel post it should run on.
giveaway.created: Done! The post now has a join button.
giveaway.exists: A giveaway already runs on this post.
giveaway.not_admin: Only admins of the channel can start a giveaway on its posts.
giveaway.no_rights: I can't edit this post. Make me an admin of the channel with the "Edit messages of others" right, then send /giveaway again.
giveaway.failed: Something went wrong. Send /giveaway and forward the post again.
giveaway.join_failed: Couldn't sign you up. Please try again.
